# VoxelGen

Generate blueprints and builds.

First, craft the "Voxel Generator" block. Then you can generate build schematics.
In survival you can use them as blueprints to guide you as you build.
In creative mode place them directly in the world.

![a 4 panel image showing generating a dragon and placing it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c722b374116191fd05b5b5f119c394e3b45f468.jpeg)


## Voxel Generator Crafting Recipe
![voxel generator minecraft recipe, features paper in the top-center, redstone in the center-center and oak planks filling every other position](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c207555b07c430cfb1827adee09c8e453a49b5af_0.webp)

## Linking Account

On first use of the Voxel Generator, you will be directed to [voxelgen.net](https://www.voxelgen.net/) to sign up & link your account.
